description: Change an existing weclapp sales order. Optional, combine as needed: planned_delivery_date (YYYY-MM-DD), customer_order_number, status (ORDER_ENTRY_IN_PROGRESS or ORDER_CONFIRMATION_PRINTED = order confirmed), items [{ item_id, quantity?, unit_price?, article_id? }] to change positions (item_id from get_weclapp_sales_order) or [{ article_id, quantity, unit_price? }] without item_id to add one, remove_item_ids to delete positions, fields (further weclapp fields). All other positions and fields keep their values: the order is read first and the change merged onto it. Fails if someone changed the order in the meantime, and reports fields weclapp did not take over. WRITES into the customer's ERP — it goes through the permission gate and the weclapp write log.

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

items.description: Positions to change (with item_id) or add (without item_id, with article_id)

sales_order_id.description: ID of the sales order to change

name: update_weclapp_sales_order
